children: Gary Mark Bendza, an officer serving as EVP, CFO, reported the sale of common stock on September 9, 2026. The filings show a weighted average sale price of $4.55 per share reflecting multiple transactions priced between $4.50 and $4.63. The total sale proceeds reported were $910,000 for 200,000 shares disposed of. After the transaction, Bendza directly owned 537,008 shares of common stock and indirectly owned 10,721 shares via a 401(k) plan.
